classes.CPoint:
Option Explicit
Private mX As Double
Private mY As Double
Public Tag As String
Public Items As Collection
Public Event Moved(ByVal dx As Double)

Public Property Get X() As Double
    X = mX
End Property
Public Property Let X(ByVal v As Double)
    If v < 0 Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1, "CPoint", "negative"
    mX = v
End Property
Public Property Get Y() As Double
    Y = mY
End Property
Public Property Let Y(ByVal v As Double)
    mY = v
End Property
Public Function Length() As Double
    Length = Sqr(mX * mX + mY * mY)
End Function
Public Sub Move(ByVal dx As Double, Optional ByVal dy As Double = 0)
    mX = mX + dx
    mY = mY + dy
    RaiseEvent Moved(dx)
End Sub
Public Function Clone() As CPoint
    Dim p As New CPoint
    p.X = mX: p.Y = mY
    Set Clone = p
End Function
Public Property Get Self() As CPoint
    Set Self = Me
End Property
Private Sub Class_Initialize()
    Tag = "init"
End Sub
classes.CBag:
Option Explicit
Private mItems As Collection
Private Sub Class_Initialize()
    Set mItems = New Collection
End Sub
Public Sub Add(ByVal v As Variant)
    mItems.Add v
End Sub
Public Property Get Count() As Long
    Count = mItems.Count
End Property
Public Property Get Item(ByVal i As Long) As Variant
    Item = mItems(i)
End Property
Public Property Let Item(ByVal i As Long, ByVal v As Variant)
    mItems.Remove i
    If i > mItems.Count Then mItems.Add v Else mItems.Add v, , i
End Property
Public Property Get All() As Collection
    Set All = mItems
End Property
classes.CWatcher:
Option Explicit
Public WithEvents P As CPoint
Public Log As String
Private Sub P_Moved(ByVal dx As Double)
    Log = Log & "moved " & dx & ";"
End Sub
classes.CErrProbe:
Option Explicit
Public Field As Long
Public Property Get Value() As Long
    Value = Err.Number
End Property
Public Function Peek() As String
    Peek = "inside " & Err.Number
End Function
Public Sub Touch()
    Field = Err.Number
End Sub
Public Function Handled() As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Handled = "inside " & Err.Number
End Function
Public Function Raises() As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Raise 1004
    Raises = "inside " & Err.Number
End Function

probes.name: is_on_values
probes.macro:
Private Function Plain() As String
    Plain = "inside " & Err.Number
End Function

Function Probe() As String
Dim v As Variant, r As Boolean, s As String
On Error Resume Next
r = v Is Nothing
s = Err.Number
Err.Clear
v = Null
r = v Is Nothing
s = s & "|" & Err.Number
Err.Clear
v = 5
r = v Is Nothing
s = s & "|" & Err.Number
Err.Clear
Set v = Nothing
r = v Is Nothing
s = s & "|" & Err.Number & r
Probe = s
End Function
